scope: Item 1 audit only; no new clinical, genetics, model or source-data execution

candidate_window.endpoint_boundary_rule: Must be frozen before labels; do not infer inclusivity from displayed dates alone

gates.name: endpoint_design_freeze
acceptance: Versioned estimands and source-specific endpoint IDs preserve original hypotheses
Freeze event window, ascertainment lag, censoring, missingness, metrics and decision routes
Record amendment reasons and outcome/prediction exposure
reject: Advancement surrogate relabeled clinical success
Outcome-adaptive window or power assumptions

gates.name: t6_reference_qualification
acceptance: Freeze fresh pilot cases and reference questions before new model output
Two blinded separated source-cited assessments with disagreements retained and adjudicated or uncertain
Record model/reviewer provenance and shared-error risks; no invented external independence
reject: Development-exposed cases called held-out
Copied source assertion treated as proof of intervention benefit
AI consensus called external scientific validation

gates.name: historical_predictors_origin_scope
acceptance: Eligible complete input lineage at every row origin
Seal origin cohort, scope and dependence components before outcome joins
Test hash/schema/semantic integrity and source/label isolation
reject: Current annotation fills historical gap
Future information-bearing model role or mapping
Unbounded availability date assumed historical

gates.name: outcome_ascertainment
acceptance: Qualified endpoint and reporting-lag evidence
Audit drug/regimen/population/role equivalence
Separate event, publication, availability and latest-observation dates
Explicit positive/negative/unresolved/censoring rules
reject: No recorded start automatically negative
Commercial discontinuation automatically biological failure
Event after endpoint counted because observed during lag

gates.name: power_and_precision
acceptance: Qualified event counts and dependence/label-error sensitivities
Calibrated null checks and retained simulations
Prespecify AUROC delta 0.05 planning target at 80% power and separate calibration precision
Retain feasibility/descriptive route if gates fail
reject: Old proxy counts treated as new-window truth
Simulation power called observed accuracy
Tune assumptions to pass after model results

gates.name: genetics_method_qualification
acceptance: Source-integrity discrepancy resolved or route explicitly quarantined
Method-specific required statistics and biological exposure contract
Coverage/alignment and independent implementation checks
Weak/conflicting/multiple-signal fixtures and limitations retained
reject: Invented N/EAF or unqualified study overlap
Wrong-order or unsigned LD used in signed-LD method
Transcript effect reinterpreted as protein/drug effect

gates.name: training_calibration_qualification
acceptance: Every feature input and contributor eligible at its row origin
Training/calibration labels available before candidate test origin
Grouped disjoint splits with train-only preprocessing and separate calibration fit
Freeze feature/missingness/scorer artifacts before test outcomes
reject: September 2024 Qwen supplies a 2023-as-of feature
January 2025 scorer fitted to later-available labels
Dependent programs leak across partitions

gates.name: matched_evaluation_activation
acceptance: Executable matched model/evidence/budget arms and genuine workflow ablations
Frozen analysis and registration decision
Isolation/canary tests pass and predictions sealed before evaluator join
Separate T6 and clinical claims and keep inconclusive results
reject: Post-selection masks reported as model reruns
Unqualified probabilities used for Brier
Exposed development cases described as untouched confirmatory set

method_specific_rules.coloc_abf: LD is not universally required. Check beta/varbeta versus p-value approximation route, trait type, case fraction, and quantitative sdY or justified N/MAF estimation route. Do not require every method to have all fields.
method_specific_rules.coloc_susie: Require harmonized signed LD with exact SNP/allele order, qualified sample size and LD compatibility; retain external-reference sensitivity and convergence diagnostics.
method_specific_rules.mr: Select estimator and required statistics before calculation. Quantify strength/overlap/pleiotropy concerns as applicable; estimates and colocalization do not establish drug mechanism.
method_specific_rules.source_md5_mismatch: Cryptographic mismatch is a source-provenance exception, distinct from statistical field requirements; quarantine scientific use until reconciled or explicitly justified under a documented source-trust policy.

chronology_rules: Every information-bearing ancestor availability upper bound must be <= row origin
computed_at may be later if inputs, annotations and derivation carry no later information
All scientific LLM contributors must have immutable pre-origin weights and no later information-bearing adaptation
Training/calibration labels must be ascertainable before test deployment origin, including reporting lag
Current source-based adjudication remains evaluator-only and cannot become historical predictor content
